mapper.select: SELECT history.id, history.from_status, history.to_status, COALESCE(NULLIF(operator_user.nickname, ''), operator_user.username) AS operator_nickname, history.created_at FROM support_ticket_status_history history LEFT JOIN sys_user operator_user ON operator_user.id = history.operator_id WHERE history.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY history.created_at ASC, history.id ASC LIMIT 50
